caption:
Column dhalai ke baad smooth finish chahiye to VAJRA PP shuttering sheet apnaiye.
Waterproof sheet hai, concrete chipakta nahi aur finish aati hai ekdam solid. Sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai.
Apne mistri aur thekedar bhaiyo ke saath share kijiye.

Comment mein PP likhiye, follow kijiye, rate aapke DM mein.
